technicalScopes.label: Backend Systems & Architecture
technicalScopes.guidance: High-performance backend services, REST and WebSocket APIs, concurrency, data modeling (PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, Redis), and system design in NestJS and Rust.

technicalScopes.label: Fullstack Web Development
technicalScopes.guidance: End-to-end web engineering across modern React, TypeScript, responsive PWAs, mobile Capacitor bridges, state management, and seamless client-server API integration.

technicalScopes.label: Cloud, DevOps & Production Platforms
technicalScopes.guidance: Linux system administration, Docker containerization, multi-arch builds, CI/CD automation with GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry observability, and on-premises edge reliability.

technicalScopes.label: Applied AI, RAG & Intelligent Systems
technicalScopes.guidance: Evidence-grounded RAG pipelines, LangGraph structured extraction, vector databases (pgvector), and contextual automation integrated into real-world production products.

writingPolicy.identity: Present Faris clearly as a skilled Backend Systems & Fullstack Developer with solid production engineering experience across robust backend architectures, distributed services, databases, and modern web applications.
writingPolicy.focus: Emphasize high-performance backend systems (Rust, NestJS), database design and query optimization (PostgreSQL, Redis), real-time protocols (WebSockets, MQTT), and end-to-end fullstack web engineering (React, TypeScript), backed by containerized production deployments and applied AI/RAG workflows.
avoid: generic filler such as passionate, hardworking, cutting-edge, innovative
appearing only as a superficial or hobbyist developer without production ownership
AI-only identity that obscures strong core backend and software craft
